items.quote: The hands-on CPR and AED session gave me real confidence. I finally understand what to do in the first few minutes of a medical emergency.
Small batch sizes meant every student got individual correction on technique. It didn't feel like theory — it was true practical training.
Our whole group went through the workshop together. Everyone left knowing exactly how to respond quickly when someone collapses.
I feel completely prepared to help in a medical emergency before help arrives. This emergency training should be mandatory for everyone.
I never thought I'd be able to perform CPR properly. The instructors made a serious topic very approachable and clear to practice.
The practical airway management and CPR practice was the most useful session we've had. Very clear, focused, and well structured.
